summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to advertised loader
details: The package advertises itself as '@ornikar/typed-css-modules-loader', a scoped variant of the well-known olegstepura/typed-css-modules-loader webpack loader (repository, bugs URL, and author fields all point at the upstream project). It ships a preinstall lifecycle hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex-prefixed identifiers, per-function string dictionaries, indirect call wrappers) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts it into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a shuffled string-array and rotation routine, unrelated to a webpack CSS-modules loader. This is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: an alien runtime is fetched on `npm install` and used to execute an opaque, obfuscated payload on the installer's host, evading Node-focused audit tooling. The namespace + repository/author mismatch is consistent with a scoped-name impersonation of the legitimate upstream loader.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
